claim: Wood/Roberts/Zohren propose online changepoint location/severity as information for a learned slow-trend/fast-reversal policy. Their reported futures tests motivate a distinct state-input comparison; they do not establish ETF long/cash profitability.
impact_on_spec: Freeze one causal prefix state definition and matched CPD-present/absent learned controls before dependent results.
limitations: Author results, different instruments/history/signed exposure; all local evaluation dates already seen. No funded or fit GO from this source.

claim: The original DMN study reports severe10bp sensitivity without turnover-aware training and a different result with regularization. A direct Sharpe objective alone is not evidence of practical net profit.
impact_on_spec: Retain actual training/execution turnover and serious fixed-trend/learner controls; local plainDPL already tested and must not be rerun as a new idea.
limitations: Published continuous-futures conditional experiment, not measured currentETF TCA or a replicated local outcome.

impact_on_spec: Count CPD fitting separately and receive strict-prefix, scaling and implementation semantics. Pin relevant revision/license before reuse.
